fusions.name: Among the Flock
fusions.desc: Throws off the fleece in the middle of them, which deals 28 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Blind Bite
fusions.desc: Pulls a hood over the target's head and bites, which deals 12 damage, stuns it for 1.2 seconds and leaves it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Strung Fladry
fusions.desc: Strings a line of cloth flags 6 tiles long across the ground for 8 seconds. Nothing crosses it.

fusions.name: Borrowed Fleece
fusions.desc: The moment you are back at full health, your next strike gains 20% critical hit chance. Once every 12 seconds. You have 25% more critical chance against enemies that have not been hurt yet.
